app.name: CRISP-QES v2
app.tagline: Enroll once, sign in seconds. No re-issuing your QES on every click, no RNOKPP on-chain.
app.footnote: Independent open-source client. Not an official Diia service. Demo runs a single-node ciphernode; not production.

landing.lede: v2.1 splits identification from signing. Enrollment with a Diia QES + Passkey happens once. After that, every petition signature is just a Passkey tap — no fresh QES, no identity reveal. The chain sees a commitment, never an RNOKPP; the guarantee is still 'one RNOKPP, one vote'.
landing.sectionLimits: What this demo does not yet guarantee
guarantees: The Diia QES handshake is a one-time event. All subsequent signing is a single Passkey tap — no per-document KEP re-issue.
Your Diia certificate and RNOKPP are seen only by your browser and the ciphernode committee. The blockchain stores a 32-byte commitment with no link to your identity.
One RNOKPP yields one commitment. Re-enrolling the same RNOKPP is rejected by the ciphernode committee before the chain even sees it.
Each signature emits a deterministic nullifier over (commitment, petition). One vote per petition is guaranteed by construction.
limits: This demo runs the ciphernode as a single server, not a 5-of-7 committee. A compromised admin of that single server could mount a Sybil attack. In production this trust is split across seven independent operators via TSS.
Proof generation runs in your browser in ~5–10 seconds (target). A modern device with SharedArrayBuffer and WebAuthn PRF support is required.
The BIP-39 mnemonic is shown once at enrollment. Save it — without it and without a synced Passkey, recovery is only possible after the next epoch.
Vote tallying is transparent in this demo. v2.2 will add FHE-aggregated ciphertexts: per-vote counts will be encrypted, and only the final result will be revealed after the deadline.

enroll.heading: v2 enrollment
enroll.intro: Done once. You prove your identity with a Diia QES, bind it to a Passkey on this device, and from then on every signature is a sub-second tap — no fresh KEP.

upload.title: Diia QES (.p7s)
upload.intro: Upload the file the Diia app produced under «Накласти КЕП». The file is needed for one thing: to prove to the ciphernode committee that you hold a valid RNOKPP. The RNOKPP itself never leaves your browser in the clear.
upload.wrongPrefix: Not a Diia QES — subjectSerial does not start with TINUA-.

passkey.title: Passkey on this device
passkey.intro: We'll create a Passkey with the PRF extension. The authenticator (Face ID, Touch ID, security key) syncs via iCloud / Google / Microsoft, so losing this device doesn't lose your Passkey.
passkey.created: Passkey created. PRF extension is active.
passkey.unsupported: This browser or device doesn't support WebAuthn PRF. Try Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge.

oprf.title: Compute the commitment via the ciphernode
oprf.intro: Your browser hashes the RNOKPP into a ristretto255 point, blinds it with a random scalar, and sends it to the ciphernode. The committee returns its share plus a DLEQ proof; the browser unblinds and obtains the deterministic 32-byte commitment.
oprf.running: Blinding RNOKPP and contacting the ciphernode…
oprf.dleqInvalid: DLEQ proof did not verify — the ciphernode may have returned an incorrect value. Try again.
oprf.pubkeyMismatch: The OPRF server's public key does not match the one pinned in the client. Possible MITM — enrollment aborted.

register.title: Register in the Merkle commitment
register.intro: The ciphernode appends your commitment to the Merkle tree and signs the new root. You then submit that signature to EnrollmentRegistry — for the demo via WalletConnect; in production a relayer does it without your wallet.
register.alreadyEnrolled: This RNOKPP is already enrolled. v2 forbids Sybil — that's the whole point.
register.submit: Confirm the transaction in your wallet

chain.title: Confirm the on-chain root update
chain.intro: Last step: sign `EnrollmentRegistry.updateRoot(newRoot, newCommitments, attesterSig)` with your own wallet. This updates the tree root in the contract — a one-time action per enrollment. You pay the gas yourself: enrollment is the one moment in the protocol where the audit story is cleaner if the citizen is the on-chain sender (not the relayer).
chain.walletConnectHint: QR code for a mobile wallet
chain.wrongChain: Switch your wallet to Base Sepolia.

errors.badSignature: Attester signature does not match the current root.
errors.emptyBatch: Commitment batch is empty — the ciphernode returned no commitments.
errors.notAdmin: Only the admin can perform this action.

backup.title: Recovery mnemonic (BIP-39)
backup.intro: These 24 words let you recover your identity on a different device — even without your Passkey. Write them down and store them safely. We do NOT store this mnemonic: lose it and lose your Passkey, and you'll have to wait for the next epoch to re-enroll.
backup.saved: I've written it down — finish enrollment
backup.warning: Never share these words. No representative of Diia, the ciphernode, or this app will ever ask for them.

done.title: Enrollment complete
done.body: Your commitment is in the tree and the mnemonic is saved. You can now sign any open petition in seconds.

vote.title: How do you vote?
vote.missingEnrollment: No enrollment on this device. Run «Enroll» or recover from your mnemonic.

unlock.title: Unlock your Passkey
unlock.intro: The authenticator returns a PRF output we use to decrypt the OPRF output and the Merkle membership proof from local storage. This is the only moment your browser handles sensitive material.

prove.title: Generate the proof
prove.intro: Your browser computes the ZK proof in ~5–10 seconds. Unlike v1, there's no 30-second RSA check inside the circuit — only a small Merkle membership and a nullifier.

submit.intro: Proof is ready. Submit your vote via the v2 relayer.

errors.NullifierAlreadyUsed: You have already voted on this petition.
errors.InvalidVote: This vote value is not allowed for the petition's mode.

recover.heading: Account recovery
recover.intro: Enter the 24-word BIP-39 mnemonic you saved at enrollment. We'll recompute your commitment, ask the ciphernode for an up-to-date Merkle path, and bind the result to a fresh Passkey on this device.
recover.invalidMnemonic: Mnemonic is invalid. Check word order and typos.
recover.restoring: Looking up your commitment in the committee…
recover.notFound: No commitment matches this mnemonic in the ciphernode. It may have been rolled into a new epoch.
recover.ok: Access restored. Create a new Passkey to finish.

done.heading: Vote counted
done.lede: Your vote on petition #{{id}} is in the contract.
